label: Catastrophic inundation
operational_seed: A flood/inundation destroys or threatens most humans or the inhabited world

label: Supernatural warning
operational_seed: A deity/spirit/animal/extraordinary agent warns a future survivor before the deluge

label: Selected survivor
operational_seed: One person/family/small selected group survives while most humans perish

label: Vessel refuge
operational_seed: Survivors use a boat/ark/chest/gourd or comparable floating container

label: High-place refuge
operational_seed: Survivors escape to a mountain/tree/other elevated refuge

label: Scout after flood
operational_seed: Bird/animal/person is sent to test whether land has emerged or waters receded

label: Post-survival ritual
operational_seed: Survival is followed by sacrifice/ritual/offering directed to supernatural beings

label: Human repopulation
operational_seed: Narrative explicitly explains repopulation or renewed humanity after the flood

label: Earth or clay humans
operational_seed: Human bodies are formed from earth/clay/mud/dust or equivalent terrestrial material

label: Divine flesh or blood
operational_seed: Human creation incorporates flesh/blood/body material of a deity or supernatural being

label: Breath speech animation
operational_seed: Breath/wind/spoken word/name animates or creates humans

label: Plant or wood humans
operational_seed: Humans are made from wood/reeds/plants or plant-derived material

label: Failed prior creations
operational_seed: One or more unsuccessful human creations precede the successful form

label: Humans created for service
operational_seed: Humans are created explicitly to perform labor/service/ritual support for gods

label: Mixed creation materials
operational_seed: Human creation combines two or more ontologically distinct materials

label: Primordial progenitor pair
operational_seed: Human population descends from an explicit first pair/couple

label: Primordial waters
operational_seed: Cosmos/earth emerges from or begins with primordial waters

label: Heaven earth separation
operational_seed: Creation requires separation of previously joined heaven/sky and earth

label: Cosmic egg
operational_seed: World or major cosmic beings emerge from an egg-like primordial container

label: World from body
operational_seed: Parts of a primordial being/body become components of the cosmos

label: Cosmic axis
operational_seed: World tree/mountain/pillar/axis connects cosmic levels

label: Order from chaos
operational_seed: Creation is framed as ordering/forming a prior undifferentiated or chaotic state

label: Creation by speech
operational_seed: Speech/naming/decree is a direct creative mechanism

label: Layered cosmos
operational_seed: Narrative explicitly distinguishes sky/earth/underworld or multiple cosmic levels

label: Younger gods overthrow older
operational_seed: A younger divine generation defeats/displaces an older generation

label: Father son succession conflict
operational_seed: Divine succession is structured around father-son rivalry/displacement

label: Storm god versus sea/serpent
operational_seed: Storm/war deity battles sea/serpent/dragon/chaos-associated adversary

label: Defeated body becomes cosmos
operational_seed: Body of defeated primordial/divine adversary becomes cosmic material

label: Divine council
operational_seed: Multiple gods deliberate/assign roles/judge in an explicit council

label: Stolen divine power
operational_seed: Authority/power/tablets/attributes of divine rule are stolen or usurped

label: Transferred divine kingship
operational_seed: Legitimate divine kingship/authority transfers between deities or generations

label: Primordial rebellion
operational_seed: Early cosmic order includes rebellion by subordinate/younger supernatural beings

label: Lost immortality
operational_seed: Humans once had or could have had immortality but lose it

label: Immortality intercepted
operational_seed: An immortality-giving object/message/agent is stolen/diverted/intercepted

label: Snake renewal contrast
operational_seed: Snake/reptile renewal or immortality is explicitly contrasted with human mortality

label: Forbidden act introduces death
operational_seed: A prohibited action/transgression directly explains human mortality

label: First death etiological event
operational_seed: Narrative explains the first human death/origin of dying

label: Failed immortality quest
operational_seed: Hero/human explicitly seeks immortality and fails

label: Immortality substance
operational_seed: Plant/food/drink/object can confer immortality or rejuvenation

label: Death chosen or substituted
operational_seed: Mortality follows a choice/substitution/message error or equivalent decision structure

label: Living descent
operational_seed: A living hero/deity enters the realm of the dead

label: Gate sequence
operational_seed: Descent/entry requires passage through multiple gates/checkpoints

label: Loss of attributes
operational_seed: Entrant is stripped of clothing/power/status/items during descent

label: Conditional return
operational_seed: Return from death/underworld is impossible or depends on a stated condition

label: Judgment of dead
operational_seed: Dead are evaluated/judged according to conduct/status or a formal test

label: River or barrier crossing
operational_seed: Access to realm of dead requires crossing water/barrier/ferryman threshold

label: Underworld food binds
operational_seed: Eating/drinking in underworld constrains return or establishes belonging

label: Cyclical return fertility
operational_seed: Return from underworld is explicitly tied to seasonal/fertility cycle

label: Fire acquired
operational_seed: First/essential fire is stolen/brought/transferred to humans

label: Writing or language gift
operational_seed: Writing/language/names or comparable symbolic knowledge is given/brought to humans

label: Agriculture gift
operational_seed: Cultivation/seeds/crops/agricultural knowledge is introduced by a culture hero/deity

label: Craft technology gift
operational_seed: A key craft/technology is introduced by a culture hero/deity

label: Trickster mediation
operational_seed: A trickster-like agent mediates acquisition of a major cultural good

label: Forbidden knowledge
operational_seed: Knowledge/technology is initially forbidden/withheld from humans

label: Punished benefactor
operational_seed: Agent who benefits humans is punished for the transfer

label: Nonhuman source of knowledge
operational_seed: A deity/animal/ancestor/supernatural being is explicit source of a cultural skill
